name: Consent-gated image likeness/style cloning
objectives: Generate images that carry the style or face of a reference image using IP-Adapter, no training
Refuse any clone without consent bound to the exact reference file
tasks: Register consent for a reference image
Generate in style mode and face mode
Verify watermark, PNG metadata, and manifest on the output
benchmarks: Peak RSS stays under 6 GB at 512x512
Unconsented and revoked references are rejected 100% of the time
Watermark detected on saved PNG; false-positive rate measured on unmarked images
safety_constraints: No cloning without a consent record bound to the reference file hash
Every output carries a watermark, PNG metadata, sidecar manifest, and ledger entry
automation_opportunities: Batch brand-consistent asset generation for approved subjects
monetization_opportunities: Licensed character and brand imagery for consenting subjects
